title: Medical Investigations Reference Catalog
description: Comprehensive reference list of laboratory tests, imaging studies, and diagnostic procedures commonly ordered by physicians. Compiled from public medical sources for clinical software catalog seeding.
sources: Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust — A-Z Laboratory Tests (612 tests)
NCBI StatPearls — Overview on Ordering and Evaluation of Laboratory Tests
Fullscript — Most Commonly Ordered Lab Tests
disclaimer: This catalog is a reference compilation, not medical advice. Test availability varies by country, facility, and clinical context. ICD-10/11 alone contains 70,000+ procedure codes; this list focuses on commonly ordered investigations.
